outcome: fetal heart rate decline (early, late, variable deceleration, beat-to-beat changes)
admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: 102 primigravidas undergoing labor induction at Shahid Sadoughi Hospital in Isfahan, Iran.
finding: Concurrent use of misoprostol and oxytocin significantly increased neonatal meconium excretion and NICU admission compared to oxytocin alone, while also showing a lower frequency of early deceleration in the intervention group.
